summary: Iteration 7 verified the new BoatDetails collapse/expand feature at 390x844 against the preview URL. All 9 review scenarios pass. (S1) Fresh device (localStorage cleared): boat-details-bar renders expanded with vessel-input, callsign-input, skipper-input, email-input and NO boat-details-collapse-btn (since incomplete). (S2) Filling all four fields with a valid email while focus remains inside the panel keeps it open (bar visible, collapse-btn visible, no summary). Clicking outside (header area) auto-collapses to a one-line boat-details-summary showing summary-vessel='Sea Breeze', summary-callsign='ZMU1234' and the boat-details-expand-btn chevron. (S3) After a full reload the panel starts collapsed (summary visible, bar not rendered) because all details are complete and open=!complete initial state. (S4) Tapping boat-details-summary re-renders boat-details-bar with boat-details-collapse-btn; clicking boat-details-collapse-btn collapses back to summary. (S5a) Clearing email and blurring: panel stays open, collapse-btn is hidden. (S5b) Invalid 'tom@' email: panel stays open, collapse-btn hidden. Restoring valid email + blur: auto-collapses. (S6) Long vessel name 'A Really Long Vessel Name Here Indeed' truncates with ellipsis (scrollWidth=304 vs clientWidth=50) while callsign ZMU1234 is fully visible on the same line; document scrollWidth=clientWidth=390, so no horizontal overflow. (S7) Validation guard regression: with vessel cleared, ticking a checklist item shows top-validation-bar AND panel is open (incomplete). (S8) Reset All dialog regression: top-reset-all-btn opens reset-all-dialog; reset-all-cancel-btn closes it cleanly. (S9) Email prompt regression: with email cleared, Export Current -> Email PDF opens email-prompt-dialog; filled delivered@resend.dev then closed without sending (no real email dispatched). Also exercised list tick (aria-checked flips) and add-item regression (TEST_regression_item submitted; panel remains collapsed since AddItemForm is outside the boat-details panel so no spurious re-expand). Only console errors are the pre-existing 404s for favicon/manifest.
critical_code_review_comments: BoatDetails.jsx uses a useRef+useEffect+onBlur pattern that correctly keeps the panel open while any inner field has focus and only auto-collapses on first transition into the 'complete' state when not focused, OR on blur outside once already complete. The useEffect depends on 'complete' only (not focused.current) which is correct — focused.current is a ref so a dependency wouldn't help; the ref is read at effect time so the mid-typing re-open after completing the 4th field is suppressed as intended.

Potential subtle edge case (not in scope): if the user becomes 'complete' while focus is OUTSIDE the panel (e.g., via programmatic/sync update), the useEffect will auto-collapse. Current flows only reach completion via typing inside, so this is fine, but worth noting for future cloud-sync-driven updates.
Summary row uses min-w-0 + truncate on the vessel <b> and shrink-0 on callsign so callsign always wins layout — verified at 390px with a 37-char vessel name. Good responsive design.
aria-expanded is correctly set to 'false' on the summary button and 'true' on the collapse button; aria-label on summary says 'Show boat details' which is accessible.

Minor nit: when 'complete && !open', inputs are not rendered at all (correct per instructions), but any pending IME composition or autofill event on those fields would be lost. Not an issue for current UX but worth noting.
No regressions detected in Reset All dialog, email prompt, list tick/add, or GPS header.
seed_data_creation: ephemeral boat state in Mongo via auto-sync (vessel 'Sea Breeze', later 'A Really Long Vessel Name Here Indeed') under an auto-generated device_id. Added one TEST_regression_item on Leaving Dock. Not cleaned up but prefixed where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BoatDetails testids: boat-details-bar (expanded section), boat-details-collapse-btn (chevron-up, only when complete && open), boat-details-summary (collapsed button), summary-vessel, summary-callsign, boat-details-expand-btn (chevron-down inside summary). Collapse is driven by (a) useEffect on 'complete' when focused.current===false, (b) section onBlur when relatedTarget is outside the section. To blur reliably from Playwright, click a stable element outside like [data-testid='app-title'] or header; re-query it each time because BoatDetails swaps between <section> and <button> on expand/collapse and old ElementHandles go stale. When testing flows that need to edit boat fields after collapse, you MUST first click boat-details-summary to re-render the inputs — they are not in the DOM while collapsed. Email prompt dialog testid: email-prompt-dialog with email-prompt-input, email-prompt-cancel/close. Use delivered@resend.dev if you must actually confirm.
